items.evidence: Acceptance test passes; it builds a fake-indexeddb store with 500 cloned cash records with prime big bets 2..3571, reads trendData, renders StatisticsScreen, asserts one title matching the regex and equal to an independently computed Σ(net/bigBet) value, no aria-busy, no load-failure message, and a finite session-grouped point. Holdout: 1000 tampered records (prime × 1000003) through the store give 2 points, first equal to the independent float-rule value, no aria-busy; real-app E2E as in end_to_end passes.

Unit test asserts 25, -1.3, -503.8 (exact path), 3.1, -3.1, Object.is 0, -6.3 negative tie, 100, tiny-negative -> +0, and a below/above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER switch-point pair whose exact and float results differ, plus all CASH_STAKES pairs vs bbPer100(...,120,n). Holdout: 300 random real-stake mixes equal bbPer100 with L=120; single hand bigBet=MAX_SAFE_INTEGER gives exact 100; coprime huge safe big bets fall back and match the float rule; +6.25 tie -> 6.3, reversed order -> -6.3; 5000 large primes with near-MAX_SAFE nets gives a finite value with no throw; empty and non-cash input still RangeError.

Unit test asserts every point is 100 under hands/session/day for 500 primes with net=bigBet. Holdout: 1500 primes with mixed-sign nets over two sessions/days give finite points in all three groupings and the rendered BB/100 card contains no NaN/Infinity.

Verification command (typecheck && no 'as' in trendHand body) exits 0; since tsc fails on unused @ts-expect-error, the test's directives are proven necessary. Holdout type file compiled with the project tsconfig: cash sources missing all fields, stake, userSeat or actions each require @ts-expect-error (tsc exit 0, so every directive is used); a real HandRecord, a source with no gameType, and a sit-and-go source type-check; HandRecord assigns to TrendSource. Runtime holdout: trendHand on a real cash record returns {net: netResult, bigBet}; non-cash has no cash.

Unit test renders StatisticsScreen with [-2,-4] and asserts break-even y1=y2=38, circles (10,94) and (390,150), polyline '10,94 390,150', 38 < every cy; [-3] gives y1=45 and circle (200,150). Values match the unchanged A-5 geometry (hi=max(1,..)); per A-3 the break-even line is the topmost element, which satisfies AC#3 in substance. No geometry code changed.
